java.say: name is public (+): every class can use it.
badgeNumber is protected (#): Keeper's subclasses can use it, and in Java also the classes in the same package.
age has no modifier, so it is package-private (~). Only classes in the same package can use it.
pinCode is private (-): only Keeper itself can use it.
Methods get a visibility in the same way. feed() is public.
checkBadge() is private: a helper for Keeper's own code.

cpp.say: name is under `public:` (+): every class can use it.
badgeNumber is under `protected:` (#): only Keeper and its subclasses can use it.
C++ has no package level (~), so this Keeper has no age field.
pinCode is under `private:` (-): only Keeper itself can use it.
Methods get a visibility in the same way. feed() is public.
checkBadge() is private: a helper for Keeper's own code.
